about: Platinum Compass roadmap: chapter columns for the missable matrix, then the stages to the platinum. Every trophy sits in exactly one stage. Story stages follow the official chapter and mission descriptions in the order GTABase's mission list [17] gives them; cleanup stages follow the roadmaps of KeenGamer [7], PowerPyx [2] and GameTrek [22].
notes: One playthrough is enough, there are no online trophies and no difficulty trophies [7][9][22]. Free roam continues after the final mission and side content stays open [15][2].

There is no mission replay or chapter select, so keep manual saves at each chapter start and before the final mission [7][13][29]. Using a cheat turns trophies and saving off for that session [9][35].
Time: about 200 hours [7][9][27]; GameTrek gives 100 to 200 [22]. Difficulty 4/10 [7][19] against 7/10 [22]: the list is long rather than hard [9].

stages.title: Prologue & Chapter 1
stages.effort: Story stages 1 to 5 together: 60 to 80 hours [7][2].
steps: Do Lucia's balcony meditation the morning after Down to Earth: it is the one spot that may not come back after Chapter 1 [25][13].
After Feng Shui, answer Cal's text and catch his Stoplight Parrotfish for Baited My Tackle [12].
Play to the end of one game on the console at Jason's house for Stick Fiddler [10][2].
Scan every passing vehicle and landmark with the WAiNK camera from now on; it saves hours later [7][2].
Make a manual save before Hey Arnold! and Tourist Trap, the chapter's points of no return [20][29].

stages.title: Chapter 2: partner unlocked
stages.when: Story · What's in the Bag? to Checking Out
steps: Coffee Break opens free play with your partner: from here Hot Together and the gym for Personal Best are possible [15][19].
Take the optional Hit Kingpin Bowling job and leave with all three valuables for Let's Go Bowling [17][2].
Breakfast Run gives Trust; the Chapter 2 trophy pops once Chapter 3 begins [17][2].

stages.title: Chapter 3: Vice City jobs
stages.when: Story · Welcome to Vice City to The Cartel Heist
steps: Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs give the Snap Gun: rob a jewelry store unseen (Sneakthief), then chain three shops with your partner (Retail Therapy) [27][2].
Do Race Against Yago when it appears: it is time-limited and Yago's strand is one that counts for Strangers & Freaks [20][9].
Credit Check gives the Dye Pack Jammer, which starts the marked-bill money for Dime on the Dollar [16][2].
The Key Cloner job opens Capital Offense and Randy's wish list [2].

stages.title: Chapter 4: heists and vaults
stages.when: Story · Ocean Beach to Starting From Zero
steps: Play the optional mission That's Where The Money Is… to open the eight bank vaults [7][27].
Rob vaults with your partner along: an escaped vault job also counts as an armored-truck escape [27][2].
Child's Play, Headliners and VCIA Takedown each give a story trophy on completion [17].

stages.title: Chapter 5 & the ending
stages.when: Story · Bird in the Hand to The End of the Road
steps: Save in a fresh slot before Chapter 5 and again before The End of the Road [29][34].
As a precaution, finish the partner trophies before the final mission [20].
Operation Savage Glory gives Snow Storm; The End of the Road is the final mission [17][40].

stages.title: Cleanup: characters & strangers
stages.when: Cleanup · any time after their chapter
steps: Finish the strands of Kenton, Billy, Randy and Bret; they stay open after the story [15][32].
Count Strangers & Freaks by watching the trophy's progress number after each strand's last mission [5][15].

stages.title: Cleanup: activities
stages.effort: The 100% checklist stages (7 to 11): about 100 hours [7].
steps: Shooting ranges first: they also raise Focus for Gunslinger [10].
Fly under bridges for the quickest stunts [2][27].
Win 20 different races; a second win of the same race does not count [15][19].

stages.title: Cleanup: crime & oddities
steps: Rob one illegal operation of each of the 9 gangs; use one of them for a 5-kill Combat Focus [8][9].
Save before stealing a jet at VCIA or a tank at Mile Zero Air Station [9][2].
Ten Pin, Bad Luck I Guess and The Truth Is Out There have no confirmed method yet: try the leads in their guides [7][27].

stages.title: Cleanup: collectibles & map
steps: Finish every meditation spot with both characters [25][19].
Clear the map fog in a slow plane without a tracker [26].
Top up WAiNK locations and vehicle scans from the Progress menu [21][16].

stages.title: Cleanup: money & property
steps: Buy the eight purchasable garages in the Vice City Real Estate app, about $160,000 in all [9][4].
Register cheap cars to the Scooter Bros app; each one needs a garage space [11][2].

stages.title: 100% & the platinum
steps: Work down Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, which appears after the story [16][9].
The platinum pops with the 54th trophy [1].
